title: BCT SEO/GEO: Week 0 baseline + keyword strategy (drafting & 3D land modeling) per seo-client-program
body:
## Approval

On 2026-11-19, Chris asked to start the SEO/GEO campaign for Borchardt Construction Technology (BCT): "same stuff as summit", with a deep dive on the website for keywords. BCT's business is construction drafting and 3D land / machine-control modeling. The site goes live at **borchardtct.com**; it is currently on the demo `bct2.castle-itsolutions.com` while hosting and DNS are being finalized.

## Goal: Week 0 baseline plus keyword strategy (seo-client-program, the same shape as summit-vcg-website #16)

Use the installed aidevops SEO tooling only: the `/seo`, `/seo-geo`, `/seo-ai-readiness`, `/seo-agent-discovery` and `/seo-optimize` commands and the skills that ship with aidevops. **Do not read files outside this repository's worktree.** There is no need to open other repositories; the Summit approach is summarized here: Week 0 baseline → keyword map → technical audit → GEO baseline → Phase 1 changes.

1. **Keyword dive** for BCT's services, using the site copy in `app/page.tsx`:
   - 3D machine-control models;
   - site takeoffs (earthwork, paving, concrete, pipe);
   - construction drafting;
   - 3D land / grading / surface modeling;
   - drone data processing;
   - GPS rover setup, localization and calibration;
   - Trimble, Topcon and Leica-style workflows, only if the site supports them.

   Build a keyword map covering intent, the target page or section, and gaps where a new page is warranted (for example, separate service pages). Use free sources: Google autocomplete and "people also ask" patterns, competitor sites in this niche, and Search Console data once the site is verified. **DataForSEO is not budgeted for BCT yet:** mark rank and volume numbers `not_measured` and do not spend.
2. **Technical audit** of the current site: titles, metas, headings, canonical, robots, sitemap, schema, performance (free Lighthouse) and accessibility. Note that it is a single page today.
3. **GEO baseline:** how AI assistants describe BCT, measured with free manual methods only and recorded as measured or not_measured; plus an `llms.txt` draft and an Organization/ProfessionalService schema draft using only facts already on the site.
4. **Phase 1 proposal:** a prioritized list of on-site changes (new service pages, copy, internal links, schema), drafted as changes in the repo. **Do not deploy.** Go-live and indexing are handled separately by Client Websites.

## Constraints
- **Facts:** client-facing claims, service descriptions, contact details and locations need source evidence or client approval. Do not invent certifications, years, reviews or locations; list them as "needs owner input".
- **No live changes:** no DNS, hosting, Vercel or Cloudflare changes, and no indexing submissions (Search Console, Bing, IndexNow) until Client Websites confirms go-live.
- **No paid spend.** No PII or secrets in the repo or comments.

## Output
Write the report to `reports/seo/2026-11-bct-week0.md`, put the Phase 1 code changes on a branch, and open a PR with `hold-for-review` (Chris reviews content).

### Files Scope
- `reports/seo/`
- `app/`
- `public/`

title: BCT SEO/GEO Phase 1: GSC + Bing verification, $5 DataForSEO baseline (gated), one-page-per-intent batch for Chris review
body:
## Approval
Chris (2026-11-19): "get on phase 1 seo/geo for bct". borchardtct.com is live (PR #8). The Week 0 baseline is in #7 / PR #9.

## Program rules (Castle IT SEO playbook, applied to BCT)
- About a 90-day horizon.
- **One major live batch per phase window.** Chris approves each exact live batch before it ships.
- No link buying, no directories, no mass city pages, no listicles.
- Phase 1 means existing-page relevance and CTR driven by **Search Console query data**: titles and metas with real places (only owner-approved locations), internal links, and **one page per intent**.
- Every client-facing fact needs owner evidence; list unknowns as `needs owner input`.

## Goal for this issue: Phase 1 prerequisites + the Phase 1 batch (draft only)
1. **Google Search Console.**
   - Verify a **Domain property** for `borchardtct.com` with a DNS TXT record in the Cloudflare zone `borchardtct.com`. Use `aidevops secret CF_API_EMAIL CF_GLOBAL_API_KEY -- …` and add only that one TXT record. Use the existing Castle Search Console setup under `~/.config/aidevops/gsc-castle-it` (service account) through the Site Verification and Search Console APIs.
   - Submit `https://borchardtct.com/sitemap.xml`.
   - If service-account verification is impossible, stop and post the exact one-step action Chris must take.
2. **Bing Webmaster.** Add `https://borchardtct.com` with `aidevops secret BING_WEBMASTER_API_KEY -- …`, verify it (by importing from GSC if available, or by the Bing DNS method, adding only that record), and submit the sitemap.
3. **Paid data (ONLY after the maintainer posts "DataForSEO approved" on this issue).** Run a one-time DataForSEO pull with a **hard cap of $5.00**:
   - rankings for the 25 keyword-map terms (from the PR #9 report);
   - an LLM Mentions baseline for borchardtct.com.
   Use `aidevops secret DATAFORSEO_USERNAME DATAFORSEO_PASSWORD -- …`. Record the balance before and after, label the spend "BCT", and **leave at least $0.99 of account balance** (Castle IT's floor). Until that approval is posted, keep these values `not_measured`.
4. **The Phase 1 batch, as a PR with `hold-for-review`, not deployed:**
   - one service page per intent, following the PR #9 keyword map (`/services/...`), with honest copy from the current site and placeholders marked `needs owner input` for deliverables, software and brands;
   - internal links from the home page;
   - updated sitemap;
   - per-page title, meta and schema;
   - no AI-sounding filler.
   Base it on `origin/main` after PR #9 lands (or include PR #9's approved content edits).
5. Write the report to `reports/seo/2026-11-bct-phase1.md`, covering the measured vs not_measured evidence, the exact proposed live batch for Chris, and the owner questions for Arek.

## Constraints
- **Do not read files outside this repository's worktree.** Use the installed aidevops `/seo*` commands.
- Only the DNS records named above. No Vercel changes, no Worker changes, no paid spend before approval, no PII.

### Files Scope
- `app/`
- `public/`
- `reports/seo/`

title: BCT: plan migration from Vercel Hobby to Cloudflare Pages (docs only)
body:
## Goal
borchardtct.com runs on Vercel Hobby, which is for non-commercial use. Write a migration plan to Cloudflare Pages (the domain's DNS and the `bct-site-proxy` Worker are already on Cloudflare). Plan only, no infrastructure changes.

## Scope
Add `docs/hosting-migration-cloudflare-pages.md` covering:
- Current architecture (Vercel project -> bct2 origin -> Cloudflare Worker -> borchardtct.com), from the repo (`cloudflare/bct-site-proxy/`, `deploy.py`, `next.config.*`).
- Next.js feature compatibility on Cloudflare Pages (e.g. `@cloudflare/next-on-pages` or OpenNext): API routes used by the lead form, image optimisation, env vars/secret NAMES only.
- Step-by-step cutover with a zero-downtime path (switch Worker origin vs. direct Pages custom domain), verification checks, and rollback.
- Cost comparison (Vercel Pro vs Cloudflare Pages free/paid) with sources.
- Risks and open questions.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Doc exists with all sections above; every compatibility claim links a source.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, emails or account IDs in the doc (gopass/env var names are fine).
- [ ] No changes to Cloudflare, Vercel, DNS or the Worker; no deploys.
- [ ] One PR to main. Do NOT merge (needs `chris-approved`).


### Files Scope

- `docs/hosting-migration-cloudflare-pages.md`
